fields.Name: T29 - Data Explorer Browse Products
fields.Description: Verifies that the Products entity opens from the Data Explorer entity tree and displays a populated grid of cheese product records.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT the Ctrl+K search box) and go to Data Explorer, then its Data section. In the left-hand entity tree locate the 'Products' entity and click it. Wait patiently if the grid is slow to load (pages can take 10-30s in this resource-constrained environment). Success is reached when a grid of multiple cheese product records (such as Burrata, Truffle Brie, or Extra Sharp Cheddar) is displayed.

judgeValidationCriteria: The 'Products' entity is selected in the Data Explorer Data section
A row grid is shown with multiple cheese product records (more than one row)
At least one recognizable cheese product name (e.g. Burrata, Truffle Brie, Extra Sharp Cheddar) is visible
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
